runtime_text_393ffa8727a0ff0f125e:
Model Validation Review
1. Choose Entire Dataset, then click Find Validation Problems to compare the selected checkpoint with every unique original image and saved label. Limited runs continue in batches.
2. Select a finding and open it in Label Maker. Use the normal drawing tools, choose Use Prediction as Ground Truth, or keep the current label. Your normal Previous/Next controls advance through the issue queue and save the original labels.
Predictions on intentionally blank images are separated as Hard Negatives; keep those images blank when the detected object should be ignored.
3. Run this analysis again after cleanup, then retrain on the corrected dataset.
Metrics Only calculates mAP/precision/recall; it does not create an editable image queue.
